title: Like it or Not, the EU and China are Already Engaged In a Trade War - The Wire China
gist: Paywalled teaser: the opening ties global trade imbalances to China's exceptionally large trade surplus and the so-called 'China Shock 2.0', and the headline argues the EU and China are already in a trade war. A caption notes Wang Wentao met Maroš Šefčovič in Brussels on June 29, 2026.

insights.claim: Global trade imbalances are broadly associated with China's exceptionally large trade surplus, which has been labelled 'China Shock 2.0'.
insights.so_what: Persistent Chinese surpluses are the backdrop for rising trade-defence measures by partners such as the EU.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie

insights.claim: The article's headline thesis is that the EU and China are already engaged in a trade war, whether or not either side acknowledges it.
insights.so_what: Expect further EU-China trade friction; the visible text gives no detail on specific measures.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie

insights.claim: Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao and EU Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič met in Brussels on June 29, 2026.
insights.so_what: Shows active ministerial-level EU-China trade channels in mid-2026.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
